name: Section Header
summary: A settings GROUP header — the hierarchy parent that a stack of setting rows sits under: a noun-phrase label, an optional "?" help, and a right-aligned action slot (a master switch, a count, a link).
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-section-header> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. It is the PARENT node of the settings hierarchy: a group title over a stack of <aha-setting-row>s. The label is the group's labelled heading (role="heading" aria-level="3") — a noun phrase in sentence case ("Presentation", "Audience settings"), never a full sentence. A muted "?" help trigger sits right after the label — the shared DS <aha-tooltip help>, the CIRCLED question glyph summoned by name from the icon library, never a hand-placed icon — and an `action` slot pushes right (margin-left:auto) to carry a master switch, a count, or a link. NO decorative leading-icon slot (SETTINGS-40): the label is text + the "?" only. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; the header is static (no interactive state of its own). Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) renders it directly (no events to wire); Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

whenToUse.when: the title of a GROUP of settings — the hierarchy parent over a stack of rows
ONE setting inside the group — a label + a control
a whole schema-driven surface of groups + rows at once

opinion.note: Name the group with a short noun phrase in sentence case ("Audience", "Interaction") — never a full sentence and never Title Case. Add `help` only when the group needs a word of guidance; keep the label itself terse. Reach for the `action` slot to hang a master switch that toggles the whole group, a count of items, or a "Manage" link — anything that acts on the group, not on one row.
